summary: Enjoy classic Rummy! Play all your cards, Jokers included, to Go Out and & win!
description:
Play the classic Rummy card game on your Android device! Made by MobilityWare – the leading card and parlor game developer – this easy to learn card game is perfect for fun and relaxation. Play Rummy how you want to play!

How to win is simple: play all your cards before your opponents!

But victory is both challenging and rewarding against opponents with adaptive skill levels. Precision, strategy and quick thinking are needed to master the game. Lay off your cards and play your sets and runs to win the game! We’ve also included clear tutorials to help you learn the game of Rummy at your own pace. Relax and train your brain as you compete in the game of Rummy!

Rummy Features:

Play the fun and relaxing version of Rummy
- Hop into the classic Rummy gameplay you know and love
- Learn the game of Rummy in a low pressure, easy to learn environment!
- Experience Rummy with the fun of Jokers!
- Drop in drop out gameplay means Rummy is ready to play whenever you are!
- Use expressive emojis to let your opponent know you are winning big!
- Play offline – bots are available to play whenever and wherever
- Need help? Use the unlimited hints and undos!

New feature: Leagues!
- Take on several groups of players as you work your way through the ranks!
- Learn advanced gameplay techniques as opponent skill increases alongside yours
- Perfect your game and earn rewards!
 
Introducing Special Opponents!
- Face off against a colorful new competitor every month and earn unique boosters, hats, emotes, and avatars.
- Embrace the rivalry and become the champion you were meant to be.

The classic Rummy game, for beginners and Pros alike
- Over 300 titles to earn and collect!
- Push for a new personal best with each hand of classic cards you play!
- Improve your play with deep statistics. Watch as you improve your strategy through each game!
 
Play Rummy how you want to
- Choose your preferred settings
- Choose either portrait or landscape to play
- Never lose a game with save states, even when the app closes!
